Generate a strong password with configurable length and characters. This free online password generator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Password Generator

Start by entering your password length, then choosing your characters from the list. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your password length.
2. Choose your characters from the list.
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Each position is selected with crypto.getRandomValues() from the chosen character pool. Generated securely in your browser with crypto.getRandomValues — never sent to a server. Use a password manager to store unique passwords.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Password Generator](/password-generator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Generated securely in your browser with crypto.getRandomValues — never sent to a server.
- Use a unique password for every account and store it in a password manager.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or installation required. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Password Generator](/password-generator) and start straight away.
